description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing books within a book tracking application. It provides endpoints to retrieve, add, update, and delete books, utilizing services and DTOs for data handling.

classes.name: BookController
classes.description: REST controller for CRUD operations on Book entities, using Spring Boot annotations for mapping HTTP requests to methods.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all books, optionally paginated.

methods.name: getGenres
methods.description: Returns the list of all book genres.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a book by its unique identifier.

methods.name: addBook
methods.description: Creates a new book entry from the provided BookDto.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing book with data from BookPatchDto.

methods.name: convertToBook
methods.description: Converts a BookDto to a Book entity using ModelMapper.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a book by its ID, returning appropriate HTTP status.
